title.narrative: Mainstreaming UNESCO's Science Diplomacy Agenda among European Institutions

description.narrative: This initiative strengthens cooperation between UNESCO and European Union institutions to advance UNESCO’s science diplomacy agenda and increase its visibility within European policy processes. It promotes dialogue and collaboration between policymakers, diplomats, researchers and international partners to address global challenges through science and international cooperation. Activities include engagement with EU institutions, policy dialogues, networking events, advocacy and partnership-building to raise awareness of UNESCO’s science diplomacy priorities and expertise. The initiative supports the integration of science-based approaches into policy discussions and contributes to stronger international cooperation, sustainable development and informed decision-making across Europe and beyond.
